## Summary Adds the Sepo agent backend to this repository so `@sepo-agent` can answer, implement, review, and fix work on GitHub. This PR adds agent infrastructure only — no application source, secrets, or branch protection are changed. Installed from the latest stable Sepo release **v0.5.0** (`self-evolving/repo`). ## Required setup after merge 1. Install the [Sepo GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/sepo-agent-app/installations/select_target) on this repository, or choose another auth path from the [setup guide](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/v0.5.0/.agent/docs/setup/setup-guide.md). 2. Add at least one model-provider secret under [Actions secrets](https://github.com/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/settings/secrets/actions): `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, and/or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. 3. Run the [Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup](https://github.com/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/actions/workflows/agent-onboarding.yml) workflow. 4. Review the Sepo setup check issue it opens and complete any remaining setup it reports. 5. If `agent/memory` is missing, run [Agent / Memory / Initialization](https://github.com/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/actions/workflows/agent-memory-bootstrap.yml). 6. Optionally run [Agent / Rubrics / Initialization](https://github.com/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/actions/workflows/agent-rubrics-initialization.yml) if this repo wants rubric steering. Also confirm Issues and GitHub Actions are enabled (Settings → General → Features, Settings → Actions → General). ## Source revision - `self-evolving/repo` @ `v0.5.0` (`5f7d2032080e9c0578d0e4cb3b98b2f695f33547`) ## Installed files - `.agent/` — agent backend (265 files), excluding generated `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/`. - `.github/` — agent workflows (28), composite actions, prompts, issue templates, and assets, merged into the existing `.github/`. - `.gitignore` — appended `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/`. ## Preserved / skipped - All target-owned `.github/` files preserved; the conflict audit found no source path that collides with an existing target path. - Root `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.skills/` were not copied (install defaults). - No application source changed. ## Validation - `npm ci`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` pass on the source at v0.5.0 (run once against the identical payload). - `git diff --cached --check` is clean. - Conflict audit: no source `.github` path collides with an existing target path. ## Skipped checks - Per-repo `.agent` build/test not rerun; the payload is byte-identical to the validated source revision. --- _This PR was created by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of @ashcoft._ @ashcoft can click here to [continue refining the PR](https://app.all-hands.dev/canvas/conversations/50a1fae3-81cd-4f66-a2cf-63ef6766a7d2) - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/1) --- ## Summary by cubic Installs the Sepo agent backend so `@sepo-agent` can answer, implement, review, and fix work on GitHub. This adds agent infrastructure only — no application source, secrets, or branch protection change. Extends the existing vendored-tooling exclusion so Codacy ignores the vendored Sepo paths. **Migration** - Install the Sepo GitHub App on this repository after merge. - Add at least one model-provider secret to Actions secrets: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, and/or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. - Run the Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup workflow and complete any setup it reports. - If `agent/memory` is missing, run Agent / Memory / Initialization. Written for commit 64930fb55a4c78bab08077e95b110535fbd2ddd0. Summary will update on new commits. ---

Confidence Score: 0/5

The PR needs access checks before triage and on its fallback path before it is safe to merge.

Findings

1.   **Denied users can run triage** ▶ 2.   **Bad output bypasses access checks** ▶ 3.  **Fork PR mentions fail** ▶ 4.  **Concurrent saves drop memory** ▶ 5.  **Failed pushes still trigger reviews** ▶ 6.  **Staged edits skip checks** ▶
Fix with agent prompt `````markdown ### Issue 1 .github/workflows/agent-router.yml:319-322 When `AGENT_TRIAGE_MODE=agent`, anyone with a known association, including `NONE`, can reach `Run dispatch triage`. The workflow gives that model provider credentials, a write-capable GitHub token, and `approve-all` before checking `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY`. A denied user can therefore spend provider credits and give instructions to a model with repository write access. Check access before launching triage, and give classification only the access it needs. **How this was verified:** The context gate accepts `NONE`, and the workflow launches triage with the resolved GitHub token before `Resolve route` checks access. ### Issue 2 .agent/src/cli/resolve-dispatch.ts:139-143 If triage returns malformed JSON or an unsupported route, this catch sets `route=answer` without applying `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY`. A user denied the `answer` route can then run another paid model with repository write access instead of receiving the normal denial. Run the fallback through `applyDispatchPolicy`, or stop without launching another model. **How this was verified:** `normalizeDispatch` can throw before the access check, and the catch emits `answer` directly; the answer job runs on that output. ### Issue 3 .github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml:12-13 Mentions in fork PR titles or descriptions run through `pull_request`, which does not receive repository secrets. The router therefore has no provider credentials, even when `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY` allows the contributor. Sepo cannot answer these requests. Use a trusted default-branch workflow for this path without executing the fork's actions or runtime. ### Issue 4 .github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml:550-559 Different issues, scheduled syncs, and memory scans clone `agent/memory` independently. `commitAndPush` then makes one plain push without fetching and retrying. Once one run pushes, another run's push is rejected because its copy is behind. This step ignores that failure, so its memory edits disappear when the runner is cleaned up. Retry against the latest branch and preserve edits when conflicts need attention. ### Issue 5 .github/workflows/agent-fix-pr.yml:undefined-330 If someone updates the PR during the agent run, the push correctly rejects the outdated starting head. But this handoff runs with `always()` and sends the earlier successful `progress_status`. The orchestrator then reviews the unchanged remote branch and can repeat the same work. Include `commit` and `push-head` failures in `SOURCE_CONCLUSION`, as the status comment already does. ```suggestion SOURCE_CONCLUSION: ${{ (steps.commit.outcome == 'failure' || steps.push-head.outcome == 'failure') && 'failed' || steps.progress_status.outputs.status || steps.response.outputs.status || 'failed' }} ``` ### Issue 6 .agent/scripts/post-agent-verify.sh:18-25 If an agent stages changes without committing, `hasChanges` still starts verification, but `changed_files` omits those files. The workflow YAML check and runtime build can therefore be skipped before the changes are published. Include `git diff --cached --name-only` and check staged whitespace too, so staging does not bypass the intended checks. ```suggestion git diff --check git diff --cached --check changed_files="$( { printf '%s\n' "$history_changed_files" git diff --name-only git diff --cached --name-only git ls-files --others --exclude-standard } | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u ``` --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

Summary

Installs the Sepo backend and GitHub workflows without changing application source. - GitHub can route requests to the Sepo agent and its task workflows.

Diagram

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[Mention or label] --> B[Extract request] B --> C{Explicit command?} C -->|Yes| E[Check route access] C -->|No, agent triage enabled| D[Run triage model] D --> F{Valid decision?} F -->|Yes| E F -->|No| G[Answer without access check] E -->|Allowed| H[Run selected route] E -->|Denied| I[Post denial] ```
